item.title: Apple AirTag 2 Drops to $89 for 4‑Pack on Amazon
item.description: Apple’s second‑generation AirTag 2 is now $89 for a 4‑pack on Amazon, matching its Prime Day low, with a $10 discount and delivery Aug 23 by Amazon.

item.title: Apple AirTag 2 Hits All‑Time Low $89 for 4‑Pack
item.description: Apple’s AirTag 2 4‑pack falls to a record $89, featuring UWB precision finding up to 50% farther, reviving interest in Apple’s tracking ecosystem.
